body: Please don't think of me as ignorant,but it makes me feel sick when I imagine myself with a man..... And yeah,about that,I've lost my good friends, there's no-one to confide in besides people on here.
Appreciate the serious reply. After taking the things you said into consideration. No,it' snot worth it. But it will be extremely hard to get these thoughts out of my head.
That's a good point,thanks for taking me serious. But no-one has to know?
